mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_name, password_hash, full_name, email, phone) VALUES (#{userName}, #{passwordHash}, #{fullName}, #{email}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_name, password_hash, full_name, email, phone, status, created_time FROM users
SELECT user_id, user_name, password_hash, full_name, email, phone, status, created_time FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, user_name, password_hash, full_name, email, phone, status, created_time FROM users WHERE user_name = #{userName}

select u.user_id as user_id, u.user_name as user_name, u.full_name as full_name, u.email as email, u.phone as phone, u.status as status,
c.customer_id as customer_id, c.user_id as customer_user_id, c.id_number as customer_id_number, c.dob as customer_dob, c.address as customer_address, c.branch as customer_branch, c.kyc_status as customer_kyc_status,
a.account_id as account_id, a.customer_id as account_customer_id
from users u left join customer c on c.user_id = u.user_id left join account a on a.customer_id = c.customer_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
